name: HP-15C Simulator
description:
HP-15C Simulator is a precise software simulation of the legendary Hewlett-Packard HP-15C advanced programmable scientific pocket calculator from the 1980s. It accurately emulates the hardware microcode, complex numbers, and matrix operations.

Features:
- Full simulation of the authentic HP-15C user interface and LCD display
- Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) logic with stack manipulation
- Advanced scientific functions including trigonometric, exponential, and hyperbolic operations
- Matrix algebra support, complex number arithmetic, and numerical integration
- Keystroke programming with persistent memory storage across sessions
